user_verification_text: It seems to be working fine

pmp_safe_area_surface_fill_v1.role: stable loader; loads diagnostics, Bank guards, and Bank Owner dependency bridge

pmp_bank_owner_dependency_bridge_v1.role: dependency bridge only; exposes existing Bank APIs across same-origin parent/iframe windows so the real Bank Owner can see them

pmp_bank_load_guardian_v1.role: Bank Load Diagnostic / guardian report source

pmp_bank_home_visibility_guard_v1.role: Bank-side visibility guard retained from previous stable state

pmp_diagnostics_owner_v1.role: Diagnostics content owner with Bank Load Diagnostic baked in

pmp_bank_native_load_order_repair_v1.reason: disabled because repaint/helper repair loop caused Bank flicker and owner/helper contention

pmp_bank_continuous_run_probe_bridge_v1.reason: disabled because the Bank problem was not the probe path

pmp_bank_load_diagnostic_visible_run_v1.reason: disabled because click interception/timing may have interfered with Bank loading

pmp_control_diagnostics_migration_v1.reason: disabled because broad migration/hiding broke tabs

pass9_interpretation.bank_owner: pmp-master-bank-tab-v1.js remains the real Bank Owner for Bank tab, shell, home, inventory list, detail wrapper, and open-bank state
pass9_interpretation.bridge_role: pmp-bank-owner-dependency-bridge-v1 only makes existing APIs visible across same-origin frames; it does not own or repaint Bank UI
pass9_interpretation.helpers_policy: helpers must not repaint, rebuild, intercept, or compete with Bank Owner for the Bank home/list surface

restore_rule: If Bank breaks again, restore to the loader plus Bank Owner dependency bridge state recorded here before adding any new helper. Do not re-enable repaint helpers or click interceptors.
